decisions.reason: The Hero V refinement does not change the requirement that the second V be constructed from shared Hero V geometry; message 112 does not specify a new second-V value.
The selected Hero V arm relationship does not change the deferred construction principles or supporting role of the E and L letterforms.
The accent's requirement to derive from Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; message 112 refines the Hero V but does not establish a new accent-specific correspondence or value.
The source decision concerns black-and-white arm geometry and does not change the deferred champagne-metal material direction or its application constraint.
Selecting and refining the Hero V arm geometry does not change the deferred requirement for cohesive wordmark kerning and rhythm.
The Hero V geometry decision is unrelated to the accepted formats for accessible design-review images.
